propositions: The completion verifier performs 84-158 file discovery requests per run, dominated by repeated read_file/search_files round-trips for files already declared in ticket file_impact, consuming wall-clock time despite cache-hit on 8.7M of 8.8M tokens.

Pre-fetching declared file_impact contents and referencing-commit diffs into the verifier context reduces request count by 20%+ (measured: f6fc 56%, e6a0 30% reduction) and stabilizes request patterns to a discovery floor when combined with trusted anti-anchoring guidance.

The close gate (graph=False) must prefetch only the closing ticket's own file_impact, not the subtree union, to respect the completion-criteria verification boundary; graph=True deep-review path ranks subtree files by cross-descendant frequency within a 30k-token budget.

Prefetched files marked as skeleton (>500 lines) must be confirmed and re-fetched by the agent as needed; the trusted guidance lives in the static system prompt before the volatile marker so successors inherit it and avoid spurious re-reads of full bodies.

The prefetch rides the byte-stable fenced ticket_context and benefits from automatic message-tail prefix cache; recovery successors receive the assembled context verbatim, with prefetch bytes counted against physical_context_ceiling so oversize sections trim rather than overflow.
